programme.desc: A family returns from traveling after many years, carrying a baby girl that everyone thinks is their daughter, before days reveal the completely different truth. Then the head of the family appears, who rejects the idea of ​​adoption despite his wife's insistence.

programme.title: Al Qafer
programme.desc: Set 150 years ago in an Omani neighborhood, the series follows a man with the extraordinary ability to hear underground water. In a time of drought and struggle, he becomes the community’s essential refuge, intertwining his rare skill with local secrets and conflicts in a historical drama exploring Omanis’ bond with water and land.
